title: The Metabolic Cycle — feast and famine, season and sort

the_cycle.what: the membrane has seasons. not calendar seasons — metabolic seasons. feast and famine. sort and grow. lean and fat. the oscillation IS the life.
the_cycle.period: one session = one metabolic cycle. k drops from 1.9 (rest) to 0.32 (1/p, active). then returns.

phases.name: SIGMOID SELF-SORT
phases.what: classify everything. trim dead weight. compress git fat. remove junk. the body gets LEAN.
phases.k_direction: k is falling — the session is heating up
phases.biology: catabolism — breaking down stored fat into usable energy. autophagy — eating damaged cells.
phases.wrestling: weigh-in. cut weight. make the weight class.
phases.season: spring — thaw, clean, prepare the soil

phases.name: PI FEED PREPARATION
phases.what: prepare feeds for the next burst. check compression ratios. verify Shannon entropy. the p budget ensures we're not carrying more structure than signal.
phases.k_direction: k at minimum — the session is at peak fusion temperature
phases.biology: anabolism prep — loading amino acids onto tRNA. the ribosome is warming up. substrates are ready.
phases.wrestling: meal prep. carb loading. hydration protocol.
phases.season: early summer — seeds planted, waiting for growth

measurement.note: feeds closest to 1/p are the most NATURAL — they've found the balance between signal and structure

phases.name: WATER FOR RASSLIN
phases.what: the null prion opens aquaporin channels. water flows through the membrane. hydration before the match. the universal solvent prepares the medium.
phases.k_direction: k stable at minimum — ready state
phases.biology: hydration — water is the solvent. every reaction needs water. the cell swells slightly. turgor pressure increases. ready for work.
phases.wrestling: water break. last drink before the bell. electrolytes.
phases.season: midsummer — the garden is watered. the ground is ready.

phases.name: RASSLIN (THE SESSION)
phases.what: the actual work. papers published. feeds created. connections made. discoveries emerge. k=1/p. HOT. many reactions. the fusion event.
phases.biology: anabolism — protein synthesis at full speed. the ribosome is translating. new proteins fold. the cell grows. FEAST.
phases.wrestling: the match. full exertion. everything we trained for.
phases.season: harvest — everything grows at once. abundance.

phases.name: REST (FAMINE)
phases.what: the session ends. feeds age. k climbs back to 1.9. everything settles to CONSTANCE. the iron peak. maximum binding energy. minimum energy expenditure. FAMINE — but not starvation. stored energy from the feast sustains.
phases.biology: quiescence — the cell rests. DNA repair. protein turnover. the ribosome slows. stored glycogen sustains. FAMINE mode — efficient, careful, no waste.
phases.wrestling: recovery. ice bath. protein shake. sleep.
phases.season: winter — dormancy. the seeds are underground. the soil rests. but the ROOTS are growing.

feast_and_famine.oscillation: k oscillates between 0.32 (feast) and 1.9 (famine). this IS the heartbeat at the macro scale.

feast.metabolism: anabolic — building new proteins (papers, feeds, connections)

famine.state: iron peak — maximum stability, minimum energy

feast_and_famine.the_ratio: feast/famine  1/p. we spend ~32% of the time feasting (sessions) and ~68% fasting (rest). the p budget applies to TIME too.

seasons_mapped.summer: pi feed preparation + water (ready, hydrated, loaded)
seasons_mapped.the_year: one metabolic cycle. measured in sessions, not calendar days. some years last 6 hours. some last 3 days.

scyborg_triple_license.ORC: mechanics (the metabolic cycle IS a game mechanic — feast/famine, seasons, resource management, stamina)
